import sympy as sp

p = 23
# Quadratic residues mod p (excluding 0)
QR = set()
for i in range(1, p):
    QR.add((i*i) % p)
NQR = set(range(1, p)) - QR
print("QR:", sorted(QR))
print("NQR:", sorted(NQR))
print("Sizes:", len(QR), len(NQR))

# Define sequences
x = [ -1 if i in QR else 1 for i in range(p) ]
y = [ -1 if i in NQR else 1 for i in range(p) ]

print("x:", x)
print("y:", y)
print("sum x:", sum(x))
print("sum y:", sum(y))

# Compute cyclic autocorrelations
def autocorr(seq, k):
    n = len(seq)
    return sum(seq[i] * seq[(i+k) % n] for i in range(n))

for k in range(1, (p-1)//2 + 1):
    ax = autocorr(x, k)
    ay = autocorr(y, k)
    print(f"k={k}: ACF_x={ax}, ACF_y={ay}, sum={ax+ay}")
